confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui price levels for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because rates vary by area and property. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the local beer level (about 2.5 to 3 times the beer anchor) because direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. Local examples were converted at a general-knowledge planning rate of about 33 THB per USD, not a live quote. FX: the 2026-10-15 RBA figure comes from two web search summaries that cite the RBA exchange rates page. I did not open that page directly. The summaries flagged inconsistent date stamps and older cached RBA pages, so the observation date should be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Thai island resort towns such as Phuket and Krabi, adjusted to Koh Samui's tourist-area prices for food, drink, and July accommodation demand.
